claimsToVerify: NO visual workflow canvas is claimed anywhere in the copy, and the hero mockup (122:2306) is a LINEAR vertical step list, not a node graph — keep it linear when the mockup is rebuilt; a drag-connect canvas would be a false claim.

NO scheduled/cron trigger appears in the copy — but the Figma frame 122:2544 is still NAMED 'Card Scheduled runs' while its text reads 'Test runs'. Anyone building from layer names could reintroduce a scheduled-runs claim. Verify the built page ships 'Test runs'.

Capabilities · 'Start on form submissions, bookings, sign-ups, page views, or an inbound webhook.' — PAGE VIEWS as a workflow trigger and INBOUND WEBHOOKS as a trigger are both high-risk. Repeated in Deep-dive ('...or page views, then gate with conditions.') and How it works step 01 ('a page view, a sign-up, or a webhook').
Capabilities · 'Test runs — Dry-run a workflow with sample input and check each step before it goes live.' — confirm a dry-run/test-run mode with sample input actually exists.
Capabilities · 'Webhooks & API — Call external services and receive webhooks (Business & up).' — plan gate AND inbound webhook receipt; verify both the capability and the Business tier boundary.
Capabilities · 'Conditions & logic — Gate steps with conditions on field values — combine rules with and / or.' — confirm both AND and OR combination are supported.
Capabilities and Deep-dive · 'Run history — Every run is logged with inputs, outputs, and status for debugging.' — confirm inputs AND outputs are persisted per run, not just status.

Hero and Built-in actions · 'notify your team' — verify this means admin notification and not a shared team inbox (a shared team inbox must never be claimed). The mockup and How it works step 02 both say 'notify admins', which is the safer wording.
Deep-dive mockup (122:2388) shows a quota line '1,284 runs this month · 500,000 included' — a 500,000-run included allowance is a concrete pricing claim; verify before shipping the mockup.

CTA · 'Start free — add workflows on Starter and up.' — plan-gate claim; confirm workflows begin at Starter (note this conflicts in tone with the hero's 'Start free' if workflows are not on the free tier).

Built-in actions · 'update datasets' / 'Add a row to a dataset' — confirm a dataset-write action exists; the mockup writes to a 'Leads' dataset, which reads close to a CRM. Aglyn must not claim a Contacts CRM.
Early access stats (shared across all three pages): '9 products built in' and '0 plugins to wire up' — confirm the product count.
